raw.buffDescription: Defenders under the effect of Unstoppable become Stun Immune, this includes Unstoppable effects triggered outside this node.\n\nEvery 10 second(s) the Defender gains an Unstoppable buff for 5 second(s). The duration of this buff is reduced by 0.50 second(s) for each Prowess Buff or Passive the Attacker has.
